#### What's great

I don’t usually write negative reviews, but my experience with Dodo Payments has been genuinely painful.

I trusted the platform with my earnings, only to have a payout placed on hold for months with very little real communication or empathy. Everything felt cold, robotic, and procedural — like I wasn’t a real person on the other side of the screen who relies on that money to live and plan life.

The worst part wasn’t even the delay itself — it was the feeling of being powerless. No clear timelines, no human-centered support, just templates and policy talk while my funds remained stuck.

When you work hard and depend on that income, this isn’t “just business.” It creates stress, uncertainty, and frustration that follows you into your day-to-day life.

Lago takes a different approach by treating billing as its own layer, separate from the payment processor. If Dodo Payments is attractive because it bundles MoR plus billing, Lago is the alternative for teams that want deep control over how usage, pricing, and invoicing are modeled—without being locked into one PSP’s billing constraints.

It shines in complex scenarios like usage-based or hybrid pricing, where accurate metering, rating, and invoice generation need to match domain-specific rules. The open-source roots and self-hosting option also make Lago appealing when data ownership, security posture, or internal compliance requirements demand more control than a fully managed MoR stack.
